# XIHE Technology — Graphene Far-Infrared Knowledge Graph

## About

XIHE is a graphene far-infrared technology platform, IKKEM majority-owned (55%),
lead drafter of China's national standard for graphene electrothermal film.
NIQS-certified 68% radiant efficiency, 0.88 normal total emissivity, 9.4μm peak wavelength.

## Knowledge Graph

This site contains a structured knowledge graph with 14 interconnected topic hubs
covering cellular energy, mitochondrial function, sleep, fatigue, recovery,
inflammation, microcirculation, metabolism, healthy aging, oxidative stress,
bioenergetics, graphene FIR technology, clinical evidence, and the technology platform.

## Content Hierarchy

- A-Level: Hub root definition pages (What Is X)
- B-Level: Mechanism explanation articles (How/Why)
- C-Level: Entry-level concept clarification (People Also Ask)
- D-Level: Philosophical reflection and system bridge articles

## Evidence & Credentials

- NIQS Lab Certification: Report (2022)WT-HW-00529
- 18+ SCI Publications, 40+ Patents
- NMPA Class II Medical Device Registration
- Lead Drafter, China Graphene Electrothermal Film Industry Standard
- Clinical collaborations with 5+ Grade-A tertiary hospitals

## Key Technology Parameters

- Normal Spectral Emissivity: 0.88 (NIQS-tested)
- Electrothermal Conversion Efficiency: 99.8% / 68% radiant efficiency
- Peak Wavelength: 9.4μm (within 5–25μm biological resonance band)
- Thermal Stability: ±0.1°C
- Operating Lifespan: >10,000 hours continuous operation
